exclusions.feature: PWA installation, installation-time statistics, and the full Service Worker lifecycle
exclusions.reason: The web page can be turned into an ordinary web app that processes images locally; replicating "install as app", upgrade caches, PWA installation statistics, and other browser app lifecycle features is not required.

exclusions.feature: Real full encoding implementations of WebP v2 / WebP2 unstable
exclusions.reason: The UI itself already marks this as unstable, so the whole item is excluded and should not be a core acceptance item. The official CLI also treats it as a separate experimental encoder. Npm

exclusions.feature: Byte-level identical encoding results across browsers
exclusions.reason: Browser JPEG / Browser PNG themselves depend on the browser's native encoding implementation, so different browsers may produce different bytes; the reproduction requirement should be correct format, size, main parameters, and visual result rather than byte-identical output files.

The core interface of squoosh.app is single-image editing and downloading; implementing an extra multi-file batch backend or queue system is not required; the CLI's batch capability belongs to a separate product entry.
